title: ILM 953 Street TC-3

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Optimized for spirited canyon carvers and urban commuters alike, the Ilm 953 Street TC-3 is engineered for responsive sport riding with pinpoint lateral stability. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at 1448g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~86 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Entry-level full face for new riders seeking basic DOT protection.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval to intermediate head shapes; TC-3 shell offers versatile fit adjustments.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Ilm ILM 953 Street TC-3: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Ilm ILM 953 Street TC-3: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Ilm ILM 953 Street TC-3. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Ilm's Full Face lineup, the ILM 953 Street TC-3 brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Ilm 953 Street TC-3 represents Ilm's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~86 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Ilm 953 Street TC-3 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
